children: Motilal Oswal's research report on Westlife Foodworld

Westlife Foodworld (WESTLIFE) reported 16% YoY revenue growth to INR7.6b in 2QFY27 (in line), its highest growth in the last 13 quarters. SSSG came in at 10.1% YoY (est. 6.5%, +4.3% in 1QFY27), the strongest in 13 quarters, driven by double-digit guest count growth in each month of the quarter. Growth was led by the everyday value platform. Momentum remained broad-based, with on-premise sales growing 17% YoY and offpremise sales increasing 15% YoY. The South market continued to recover, with performance now converging with the West. October momentum was similar to 2Q, with management indicating high-single-digit SSSG as the floor for the festive season.

We believe regional demand will see a gradual improvement and, therefore, expect a gradual ADS recovery in the near future. We value the stock at 25x Sept’28 EV/EBITDA (pre-IND AS) to arrive at a TP of INR600. We reiterate our Neutral rating.
